source.text: Adiabatic limit: the fuel interior keeps all the energy deposited by the pulse (50000 J/m), so its temperature is the root of the integral of c dT = E'''. The tolerance is 0.5% of the rise, set before any run from the first-order error of the time step (about 1/N of the energy over a ramp of N steps, cancelling over a symmetric pulse).
source.check: Second method: oracles/transient-case-reference.py (decimal arithmetic, reads the case file) gives 632.802419 K; FEED's independent finite-volume solution (src/core/transientFv.ts, validated against exact cylinder solutions) agrees at the pulse end.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin, the same pulse with a fuel heat capacity linear in temperature (carried by OFFBEAT's steel1515TiBanerjee model), step 0.025 ms
